question: What great attainment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation form a great accomplishment
This accomplishment belongs to the yoginis
One possessing it may become dear to them
inference: Attaining the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation.
